overview_description.description: Montiplay is a UAE-based EdTech and early childhood development startup that provides Montessori-inspired educational toys, parenting guidance, and science-backed learning programs for babies and toddlers aged 0–3 years. The company combines Montessori education principles with modern child-development research to help parents support cognitive, sensory, and motor skill development during a child’s formative years.
